headline: Hilton Metal Forging Limited announces rights issue at ₹1,668 per share in 29:60 ratio
sum: Hilton Metal Forging Limited's board approved a rights issue of equity shares in a 29:60 ratio (29 new shares per 60 held) at an issue price of ₹1,668 per share. The announcement was made via NSE disclosure on 13 March 2026.
implication: Rights issues trigger SEBI (ICDR) Regulations 2018 Part C compliance (pricing formula, shareholder approval, listing approvals, escrow mechanics); confirm whether preferential issue or fully subscribed rights, and whether any promoter dilution or lock-in waivers apply post-issuance.
detail: The Board of Directors of Hilton Metal Forging Limited, at a meeting on 13 March 2026, resolved to issue equity shares on a rights basis. The ratio is 29 new equity shares for every 60 equity shares currently held by shareholders. The issue price has been fixed at ₹1,668 per share. The announcement was formally conveyed to the National Stock Exchange of India Limited (NSE) in compliance with securities regulations.
